test_object_detection_api: test the object detection API by sending an image and verifying the response contains labels, scores, and bounding boxes
run_object_detection_test: run the ObjectDetectionTestCase to validate the object detection endpoint returns correct JSON response format
review_object_detection_testcase: review the ObjectDetectionTestCase class that tests object detection with parameterized model IDs and sample images
create_object_detection_test: create a test that reads an image file and posts it to the object detection API endpoint
refactor_object_detection_testcase: refactor the ObjectDetectionTestCase to add new test cases for different image formats or edge cases
